prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” digital marketing agency for every business — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, and the services you need. I can help find the best fit for you, but first a few quick questions:

1. What are your primary goals? (e.g., more leads, ecommerce revenue, brand awareness, SEO, paid ads, social, website redesign)  
2. What’s your monthly/annual budget for agency services?  
3. Are you B2B or B2C, and what industry are you in?  
4. Do you prefer a local St. Louis agency (onsite meetings) or are remote OK?  
5. Do you need a full-service agency or specialists (SEO-only, PPC-only, creative, web dev)?

How I can help next
- If you give the answers above I’ll produce a tailored shortlist (3–6 agencies) in St. Louis with strengths, pricing ballpark, recent case examples, and questions to ask them.  
- Or I can give a general list of reputable local agencies and how they differ.

Quick tips to evaluate agencies
- Look for measurable case studies and references in your industry.  
- Check third-party reviews (Clutch, UpCity, Google) and LinkedIn client testimonials.  
- Ask for KPIs, reporting cadence, and who will be your day-to-day contact.  
- Prefer agencies that provide a short pilot project or 60–90 day roadmap before long contracts.  
- Red flags: vague promises (“we’ll get you to #1”), no clear reporting, inability to show results or references.

Questions to ask prospective agencies
- What results have you achieved for similar clients? (Ask for numbers: traffic, leads, conversion rate improvements, ROAS)  
- Who will work on our account and can we meet them?  
- How do you measure success and how often will you report?  
- What’s your pricing model and contract length? Any onboarding fees?  
- Can you share references I can contact?

If you want, tell me your goals and budget and I’ll research and recommend 3–6 St. Louis agencies that would be a good match.
